title: Skeptic Carl Pflock's only visit to the crash site

tellings.quote: The only skeptic that has ever been here was Carl Flock. That's because I drove him out here and walked him around and he lived two hours away.

plain: Only one skeptic has ever visited Hart Canyon near Aztec, New Mexico, where, as the episode tells it, a craft carrying sixteen alien bodies came down. That skeptic was the writer Carl Pflock, and he came only because Scott Ramsey drove him there. Ramsey tells Michels first-hand that he walked Pflock around the site, even though Pflock lived only two hours away, and he uses this to say that doubters rarely take the trouble to look.
